create.name: Pavlina Nehrebecki
create.bio:
Pavlina Nehrebecki is a yoga, meditation and breathwork teacher based in Gentofte, just north of Copenhagen, whose work centres on deep rest. After university study in several European countries she built a career as a creative producer in London's events industry, until the pace of that life sent her to India to study yoga. She came back, left her agency and began teaching, first movement, then breathing practices, then meditation. Her training runs to more than 700 hours of yoga, yoga nidra with Uma Dinsmore-Tuli and Ally Boothroyd, Vedic-style mantra meditation with Jonni Pollard of 1GiantMind, functional breathing with Michael James Wong and James Dowler, and somatic and nervous-system study.

Becoming a mother, first in London and then in Denmark, shaped what she offers now. Most of her classes and programmes are for women, and especially mothers, who want to slow down and recover their energy: weekly yoga with yoga nidra, an eight-week group course on the art of rest, day retreats, cacao ceremonies and one-to-one sessions, held in studios around Copenhagen and online. She also works with companies, and for the Just Breathe school she designed and leads a certified yoga nidra teacher training and mentors trainee meditation and breathwork teachers.

courses.title: Deep Rest: Your Portal into Clarity and Vitality (In Person)
courses.description: An eight-week small-group course in Gentofte on learning to rest well, meeting on Friday mornings with a break over Christmas. Each week combines live yoga nidra, a short teaching on how rest affects body and mind, journaling prompts and recordings to practise with at home.

courses.title: RESOURCED: A Day Sanctuary For Mothers
courses.description: A one-day retreat for mothers at a studio in central Copenhagen. The day moves from gentle yoga-based movement into yoga nidra, then quiet journaling and conversation, and closes with a cacao ceremony; lunch and refreshments are included.

courses.title: Cacao & Collage: The Quiet Season
courses.description: A three-hour afternoon gathering in Frederiksberg for the darker months, led with collage artist Catalina of Art Khemia. It opens with ceremonial cacao, moves through free movement and stillness, and ends with intuitive collage made alone and then together.

courses.title: 1:1 support sessions
courses.description: Private sixty-minute sessions online or at her space in Gentofte, shaped around the person and drawing on breathwork, meditation, somatic movement, ritual and deep rest. A free 45-minute discovery call comes first; packs of six are also offered.

free_resources.title: Pavlina Nehrebecki on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her yoga nidra practices of different lengths, a short talk and a gentle movement video, free to use in the app or on the web.
